summary: Chests for any game: the title's lootboxes with every way to open them, once or ten at a time, with an opening animation.
description: A ready chests screen (Unity LootboxOpeningPopUp) for ANY game, built on the @idosgames/react/ui kit and client.lootbox. Every lootbox of the title as a card for each way to open it (currencies, a chest item, a key); 'Open' once, and 'Open ×10' where the lootbox's ceiling (MaxOpenCount) and the player's balance allow — the box shakes while the server rolls it, bursts, and the rewards fly out. The inventory hands a chest or key item over (ctx.features.open('lootboxes', { itemID })) — the screen then shows what that item opens. Registers the 'lootboxes' feature; its badge counts chests the player can open with the items they hold.
provides: lootbox list with every way to open
open a chest with a key item
